findings.text: Open the lid: the two arms move at once in 2 stretch(es) where the commode stands still (LEFT move_to_half_pole_length + hand_grasp || RIGHT move_to_inspect + move_to_inspect_pole_length + hand_grasp; LEFT move_to_rest || RIGHT hand_grasp + move_to_inspect): the plan's own moves, their clearance checked on the robot before the task (within 50 mm: one after the other, as the plan).
RIGHT row 9, program 4: the controller first moves the arm 1 deg to the program's first point, at its Start % (30 %): that move takes 0.4-0.5 s on the robot, which widens this arm's timing from here.

Open the seat: the two arms move at once in 1 stretch(es) where the commode stands still (LEFT move_to_half_pole_length + hand_grasp || RIGHT move_to_inspect + move_to_inspect_pole_length + hand_grasp): the plan's own moves, their clearance checked on the robot before the task (within 50 mm: one after the other, as the plan).

Close the lid: the two arms move at once in 1 stretch(es) where the commode stands still (LEFT move_to_half_length + hand_tenth_grasp + move_to_start || RIGHT move_to_inspect + move_to_half_length + hand_tenth_grasp + move_to_start): the plan's own moves, their clearance checked on the robot before the task (within 50 mm: one after the other, as the plan).

The lid and seat tasks are ALIX's plans, made with the UGV at 250 mm from the commode and no offset: no UGV placement is recorded with this run's Programs, so they run where they were made, the wrist camera checking the commode's place at each task's first look.

Open the lid (35.4-56.6 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner allows the hands on the commode; a closing's contact forces are checked on their own, in the finding about them); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (56.6-60.4 s) is Lite's own, checked here.

Open the seat (87.5-111.6 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner allows the hands on the commode; a closing's contact forces are checked on their own, in the finding about them); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real. Each arm's move to its next task's start after it (111.6-115.4 s) is Lite's own, checked here.

Close the lid (202.2-218.8 s) is ALIX's plan: its hands hold the lid and the seat by design, so it is left out of this collision check (ALIX's planner allows the hands on the commode; a closing's contact forces are checked on their own, in the finding about them); its camera checks are assumed here, and asked of the camera in Real.

Close the lid: the hands press up to RIGHT 38 N on the lid (IRH_right_thumb_3, move_to_pre_start + move_to_start as one stream, 216.2 s); LEFT 18 N on the lid (ILH_left_little_1, execute_path + move_to_rest as one stream, 211.8 s). Over 20 N: RIGHT 216.2-216.2 s up to 38 N (move_to_pre_start + move_to_start as one stream); RIGHT 216.4-216.5 s up to 28 N (execute_path + move_to_inspect as one stream); RIGHT 216.6-216.6 s up to 22 N (execute_path + move_to_inspect as one stream). A sensible contact takes a few newtons (the 29 Oct hold: 6 to 8 N); Lite refuses Real over 40 N for 0.2 s or more (here 0 s; model: glove 20 mm at 3.5 N/mm, the commode [20.0, 5.0, -10.0] mm off ALIX's place, the lid 1.2 kg, open to -105.57 deg at the wall).

The two arms come closer than 50 mm: LEFT row 11 (Program 5 // 5_L_P3_R08+R09_PART1+R09_PAR, line 7,325) and RIGHT row 12 (Program 6 // 6_R_P3_T04+wait20.1s+T05+T06, line 7,047), about 178 s in: touching (IRH_plam, L_ConnectorLink) when the RIGHT arm runs 8.4 s ahead of the LEFT (in 4 of the 22 timings checked, from +6.5 to +9.4 s). Those timings are within the robot's ranges: keep the arms apart with a Meet or a Wait-for between those rows.

The two arms come closer than 50 mm: LEFT row 5 (Program 1 // L_P1_R01+R02+R03+R04_pole50_, line 1,091) and RIGHT row 5 (Program 1 // R_P1_R01_PART1+R01_PART2+R02, line 955), about 12 s in: touching (IRH_right_index_2, L_Link6) at every timing checked: those rows put the arms that close whatever their timing. Change those steps (the arms' poses or hands there).

PART 4 has its two arms going on their own for long (no Meet in it): their timings can drift up to 22.2 s apart (each arm's steps' ranges added up), so the 21 timings checked are up to 1.1 s apart and a closer approach between two of them can be missed. A Meet or a Wait-for in it makes the check finer.
